Polyfill of the Barcode Detection API for the pickers' scanner (#59).
Loaded by static/js/scanner.js only when the browser has no native
BarcodeDetector (iPhone/Safari, Firefox). Served from here: no CDN requests.

ponyfill.js        barcode-detector 3.2.2, dist/iife/ponyfill.js (MIT)
                   https://www.npmjs.com/package/barcode-detector
zxing_reader.wasm  zxing-wasm 3.1.3, dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm (MIT)
                   sha256 2ebda08a93eea3efcd8399cda6b276e6a0b1de4fec60b4d8988a047de4c6d1ba
                   (the same hash ponyfill.js expects)

To update: take the two versions together (barcode-detector pins the exact
version of zxing-wasm), copy the same two files and check the .wasm's hash
against the one written in ponyfill.js.
